|id=srparasites:carrier_light
}}'''Light Carriers''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Inborn Parasites|Inborn]] Tier.

==''Spawning''==
*Spawns from [[Evolution Phases|Phase 1]] to [[Evolution Phases|Phase 4]] with spawnweight of 5.

==''Behavior''==
Light Carriers are Small Infestation Propagators that hold other infectors.

* Light Carriers will explode when they get close to the entity they are targeting or upon death (assuming they are not on fire). 
** This explosion can spawn several mobs ([[Light Carrier#Carrier Mob Contents|More info below]]), place [[Residue]] in a 7x7 area, and will inflict the [[Viral]] and [[Vomit]] effect.
** The area where they exploded will spawn the aforementioned Mobs together with a Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] Cloud<ref>This unique effect cloud is known in the mod as "srparasites:cloudtoxic."</ref>.

* Light Carriers are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
{{Variants|count=1|Empty=Light Carrier.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Light Carriers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Light Carriers if set on fire will not explode and release anything upon death.

==''Trivia''==
*Light Carriers are also known as '''Gothol''' in the Mod Files.
*Light Carriers resemble flood carrier forms from Halo, both in appearance and in function.
*The stench of a Light Carrier is described with extreme specificity, being said to be like "spoiled cooked meat sealed in a warm container".
